steps.note: Enable eRFX projects as required for the draft.
Apply the required tenant configuration for event creation.
Apply the specified stage configuration before testing.
Give the draft a searchable title; draft creation requires a title.
Apply a pricing template so the draft can be saved.
Add the minimum line item required for a valid eRFX draft.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Commit a schedule so the draft is fully initialized.
Create the saved, unpublished eRFX draft used by the attachment test.
Navigate to the events list to locate the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Verify the newly saved draft appears in the Drafts list.
Confirm the event is still an unpublished draft.
Reopen this plan's saved draft for the attachment-window test.

args.goal: On the buyer's saved eRFX draft, click Add Attachments, leave both the file drop area and URL field empty, click Save, and record whether a validation error appears or the attachment window closes while the draft state is preserved.

steps.note: Perform and observe the attachment save behavior that no catalog-specific attachment step can express.
Assert the draft screen remains identifiable after the empty attachment save attempt, whether the window stayed open or closed.
